styles.terse: as few words as possible, no punctuation
styles.polite: polite, with please or could you
styles.typos: one or two typos or missing letters
styles.slang: abbreviations like tmrw, pls, w/, gonna, rn
styles.run-on: spoken style, long, a filler word or a correction mid-sentence
styles.indirect: says the need, not the command ("I keep forgetting to water the plants")
